description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's behavior when encountering missing commit objects. It sets up test cases by creating commits and tags, deliberately corrupts the repository by removing an object, and then checks if various Git commands correctly identify the corruption.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed based on the provided script block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used to verify detection of corruption.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used for commits, ensuring unique commit times.
